scope or original native-attempt authority. Invented arithmetic fixtures reuse
the declared 366/367 builders; no fixture energy is a new native measurement.

Actual bounded-worker inputs, plans, immutable receipts, artifacts and retained

No RNA native library, acquisition, network, HPC or episode loop is required.
